feed.title: Bullpen Phone: Washington Nationals reporter posts

entry.title: Rhylan Thomas: The #BlueJays have signed OF Rhylan Thomas and RHP Yeuris Jimenez to milb deals. Jimenez (25) posted a 4.83 ERA in 54 A+/AA innings in Nats system last year. Thomas (26) owned a .688 OPS across three orgs last year (including Toronto) and played 3 MLB games for Seattle in 2025
A. J. Puk: Happy Thanksgiving. The Nationals signed their first MLB free agent of the offseason late last night, taking a $5 million gamble on reliever A.J. Puk. natsjournal.com/p/nats-agree...

Curtis Mead: Paul Toboni keeps saying the Nationals can't assume their offense will continue to be great in '27, especially after the trades of Curtis Mead and Luis Garcia Jr. Reports by FanSided and @spencernusbaum.bsky.social of interest in Jazz Chisholm fit that theory. natsjournal.com/p/nats-still...

Jared Simpson: The Nationals have re-signed LHP Jared Simpson (who was non-tendered Friday) to a minor-league deal with an invitation to spring training. Also signed RHP Marc Church (30 games with Rangers’ AAA team this year) to minor-league deal.
Braxton Roxby: The Nationals also traded RHP Braxton Roxby (who was DFA’d this week) to the Cubs for cash considerations.

Washington Nationals offseason notes: The Nationals non-tendered LHP Jared Simpson as well as RHP Josiah Gray and LHP Carson Palmquist (who were both DFA'd earlier this week). All other unsigned players were tendered a 2027 contract, including the 3 arbitration-eligible guys: CJ Abrams, Jake Irvin and Jake Bird.
Gus Varland: Mets announce they've claimed Gus Varland (who was DFA'd earlier this week) off waivers from the Nationals.

Omar Cruz: Nats have signed LHP Omar Cruz and INF Carlos Mendoza to minor-league contracts with spring training invites. Cruz pitched in Padres system last 3 years, had 14.1K/9 IP this season at AA/AAA. Mendoza is left-handed utilityman who had .727 OPS with Blue Jays' AAA team this year.
Josiah Gray: The Nationals’ decision to DFA Josiah Gray was a tough pill to swallow, but it was a reminder this front office isn’t beholden to players it inherited. natsjournal.com/p/despite-in...

Jacob Young: Paul Toboni first noticed Jacob Young in 2021, when he admittedly was scouting some far-more-touted prospects at the University of Florida. Five years later, they shared a dais to discuss Young’s first MLB contract extension. natsjournal.com/p/with-exten...

Washington Nationals: bullpen: Everyone knows the Nationals need significant bullpen help, but what’s the best way to do that? Go all-in on one of the few proven available closers? Sign multiple (more affordable) veteran setup men? A look at some of their options: natsjournal.com/p/whats-the-...
José Tena: The Guardians have claimed José Tena off waivers from the Nationals. Cleveland dealt him to Washington in the 2024 Lane Thomas trade.

Reiver Sanmartin: Nationals have acquired LHP Reiver Sanmartin from the Giants for RHP Robert Cranz. Sanmartin, 30, had 4.22 ERA, 1.359 WHIP in 24 games this season, was DFA'd earlier this week. Cranz, 7th round pick in '24, had strong year with Wilmington and Harrisburg, struggled at Rochester.

Washington Nationals: payroll and ownership: The Nationals enter the offseason with by far the fewest dollars committed to their 2027 roster than any team in baseball. There’s money to be spent on upgrades, even if they don’t exceed their 2026 payroll in the end. natsjournal.com/p/nats-have-...

Nate Furman: Parker and Tena are probably the most-notable moves here. Parker was going to arbitration-eligible after having TJ surgery in July. Tena was out of options and less defensive value than the just-acquired Nate Furman.

Tony Neubeck: The Nationals announce they've acquired 2B/3B Nat Furman from the Giants for minor-league LHP Tony Neubeck. Furman, 25, played in 22 MLB games this season, going 4-for-32. Lefty hitter slashed .292/.377/.414 at AAA. Has 2 more option years. LHP Richard Lovelady was DFA'd to clear a 40-man spot.

Stephen Strasburg: After delivering the best season by a Nationals pitcher since 2019 and becoming their first pitcher to sign an extension since Stephen Strasburg, the expectations for Cade Cavalli will be sky high next year. natsjournal.com/p/expectatio...
